title: Add Shared Tracks tab to Playlists page
acceptance_criteria: Tab type extended to include 'shared-tracks' (type Tab = 'my' | 'shared' | 'shared-tracks')
Third tab button added to the tab bar with Users icon and label 'Shared Tracks'
Tab shows shared tracks in a grid using TrackCard component
Tab has empty state: 'No tracks have been shared with you yet'
Tab shows loading skeleton while fetching
Each track card shows 'Shared by {sharedByDisplayName}' attribution
All new elements have data-testid attributes
Responsive at all breakpoints (matches existing grid layout)
